original_benchmark.notes: ERQA (Embodied Reasoning Question Answer, Google DeepMind) ships a single 400-row test split with public ground-truth answers, so no held-out split problem. Official scoring is exact match on a single option letter after prediction.replace('.','').strip().lower(). The upstream harness is a direct VLM call with interleaved images; this adapter turns each row into a scaffold-agnostic agent task whose images are files on disk and whose perception is an optional HTTP service.

sagent_adapter.notes: No parity run performed by this adapter task; artifact correctness only. Reference points from the SpatialClaw reproduction on the same 400 rows with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: 59.5% with perception tools, 47.0% no-tool CoT baseline. Composition: 287 single-image, 113 multi-image; question types Spatial Reasoning 84, Action Reasoning 72, Trajectory Reasoning 66, State Estimation 55, Task Reasoning 38, Multi-view Reasoning 37, Pointing 34, Other 14. Answer distribution A 123, C 98, B 96, D 83. Verifier is exact-match-first with a bounded extraction ladder; a reasoning dump with no stated letter scores 0 by design.
